court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court, Bandra in M. J. Petition No. A-2859 of 2016
case_name: Mrs. Gauri Adesh Parab (Nee.Ms. Gauri ... vs Adesh Ashok Parab
facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife challenged the order rejecting her application for interim maintenance. She claimed she was earning Rs.39,000/-p.m. and husband was earning more than Rs.2 lakhs per month. She left her matrimonial house in October 2015.

legal_principles.principle: Maintenance shall be fixed considering the respondent's own income and other property, conduct of the parties.
legal_principles.held: Section 25 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, provides guideline to decide maintenance.

legal_principles.principle: The spouse who has no source of income or same is insufficient, he/she is entitled to enjoy the same standard of living as per spouse having higher income.
legal_principles.held: It is true that the spouse who has no source of income/ or same is insufficient, he/she is entitled to enjoy same standard of living as per spouse having higher income.

outcome.final_order: The impugned order rejecting the petitioner-wife's application for interim maintenance is set aside.

use_for_drafting: responding to an interim maintenance application
